description: This PHP source file defines the I18NTranslationImportAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling the import of internationalization language files (XLIFF/XML formats) via a REST API endpoint. It includes annotations for OpenAPI documentation, utilizes several traits and external libraries, and implements the create method to process file uploads, validate them, and perform import operations within database transactions.
